hedging_delta.evidence: More conditional language on device fab closure timing, PMT terms, and 'no assurance' caveats vs prior call's firmer commitments.

guidance_direction.evidence: Prior guided Mohawk Valley $40-50M for Q4; actual came in at $41M (low end) with deferral; FQ2025 CapEx cut to $1.2-1.4B from prior $1.4-1.6B range.

quant_claim_escalation.evidence: FY2025 gross CapEx now $1.2-1.4B vs prior guide of $1.4-1.6B; also FY2024 cash of $2.2B vs prior guided $2.2-2.4B range, at low end.

new_topic_rate.evidence: New emphasis on 800-volt EV architectures (70% of design-ins) and 150mm device fab closure evaluation, absent in prior call.

tone_delta.evidence: Less superlative language; prior call's 'strongest value proposition ever' language replaced with more measured 'encouraged by positive results.'

demand_language_delta.evidence: Prior call: EV device revenue up ~48% YoY; current call cites EV revenue up 100% YoY but design-in growth slowing ($2.8B prior single quarter vs $2B this quarter) and I&E still weak with inventory reduction needed.
